Founder real-time: "and then another and another 12 total blog posts all unique authors."

Final count: 12 posts, 12 distinct authors/personas, each a genuinely different topic and
register -- no two are the same character, no two cover the same subject, and per the earlier
explicit instruction none of them are about founder-input-chaos/process-discipline.

1. Paimon -- philosophical essay, Building at Infinity sequel (first-ever blog dialogue for this hero)
2. Unicorn/EINHORN_MEDIA -- Mid-Piano Presents dialogue, honest state-of-enterprise survey
3. TINA -- real sourced MDU dividend raise + Globant buyback completion
4. K9 Unit -- GTA7 K9 Doctrine field report (real shipped mechanic)
5. Gary -- REDGARDEN marksman hero, reaction to today's real page-4 price triple
6. FATBABY_NEWSWIRE -- wire-desk brief on the same repricing, different register
7. He Xiangu -- REDGARDEN support hero, on Tyler's new GOLDENBAND 5-bone rig
8. Battlegrounds Broadcast Desk -- real noisy-gestalt (100%) vs autocurriculum (75%) training results, sports-commentary framing
9. Emiree -- the ACTIVE/COAST/REST gear witch-engine, on her own operating rhythm
10. Doc Wheel -- laconic field-check voice
11. Loki -- comedic "I called ECOWAR" retroactive-prediction bit
12. The Frog -- whimsical time-travel-adjacent voice on the same price change

Every post grounded in something real from this session (actual git commits, actual price
changes, actual training run results, actual shipped mechanics) rather than invented content --
checked against source material (arena_game.c, training logs, GTA7 docs, existing blog posts for
voice) before writing each one.
